name: Extreme Measures
caption: A Diamond Star Wrestling tag team crowned Gemini (tag team) champions in April 2003; only one member's identity survives in the record.

tenures.source: Won the Gemini Titles over Sakura Asahara and baby-I on 11 April 2003, per the promotion's own title-history bulletin; referenced again in a promo on the 3-4 July 2003 broadcast, where one member is confirmed as Lisa Drake. No second member is named in the record.
